rationale: Eliminates the $9,500 cash gap by synchronizing 28-30 contiguous plots with 10-11 hands through a Day 14 freeze to maximize compounding Strawberry flushes, while raising the uncontracted surplus liquidation trigger from 4 to 14 items (or shed_used >= 36) to maintain an inventory buffer that instantly captures 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop premiums instead of dumping at depressed open market floors. Resolves harvest delays by enforcing pre-harvest well refills for zero-delay in-situ watering, and fixes the critical terminal clearance flaw of prior mutations by executing progressive shed liquidation across Day 30 (steps 704-717) rather than prematurely dumping at step 696 before Day 30 harvests are collected.
